item.title: She Was Accused Of Killing Two Husbands
item.description: Colleen Ann Harris was convicted of murdering her third husband, Robert Harris, after fatally shooting him as he slept in their California home in 2013. Decades earlier, she had also been tried for the death of another husband but was acquitted. The second conviction cemented her reputation as one of California's most notorious "black widow" killers.

item.title: The Night Brandi Worley Destroyed Her Family
item.description: In 2016, Brandi Worley killed her two young children, Tyler Worley and Charlee Worley, inside their Indiana home during a bitter divorce. After the killings, she called 911 and admitted what she had done. The heartbreaking case shocked the nation and highlighted the devastating impact that family breakdown and domestic conflict can have when they end in unimaginable violence.

item.title: Barbara Opel's Deadly Murder Plot
item.description: In 2001, Barbara Opel orchestrated the murder of her acquaintance, Jerry Heiman, after learning he possessed a valuable coin collection. Prosecutors said Opel recruited several teenagers to carry out the brutal killing before attempting to steal the coins. She was convicted of aggravated murder, and the shocking case became one of Washington state's most disturbing examples of manipulation and greed leading to violence.

item.title: The Bever Brothers' Chilling Plot
item.description: In 2015, brothers Robert Bever and Michael Bever carried out a deadly attack against members of their own family in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma. Investigators later revealed the brothers had allegedly planned to commit one of the largest mass killings in U.S. history. The case shocked the nation and raised difficult questions about warning signs, mental health, and preventing acts of extreme violence.
